name: Tm Visualization Suite: Variance & Targets
pitch: Compare actual to plan and target for every item, and see who is ahead, who is behind and by how much.
question: Are we on plan, and where do we miss the target?
useWhen: Compare actual values with plan, target and ranges.
features: See how the pieces add up
Show the gap to plan for each item
Track a value against its accepted range
Check if you are on pace for the year

hero.alt: Bullet chart of actual, target, plan and range for eight items, with the bar reaching the target for some items.
hero.caption: Actual against target for every item, with the accepted range

screenshots.alt: Bullet chart of actual, target, plan and range for eight items in fiscal year 2025.
screenshots.caption: Pick another cycle and every bullet updates to it

screenshots.alt: Variance bars for fiscal year 2025, increases to the right and decreases to the left of zero.
screenshots.caption: The gap to plan can look very different from one cycle to the next

questions: Which items miss their target this cycle?
How did actual change against plan, item by item?
Are we on pace to reach the year-end target?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who report actual against plan and target in finance and operations.

featureStrips.heading: See how the pieces add up
featureStrips.text: A waterfall starts at the opening value and adds each increase and decrease, so you see what moved the total.
featureStrips.alt: Waterfall chart from an opening value of 605 to a closing value of 620 with increases and decreases per item.

featureStrips.heading: Show the gap to plan for each item
featureStrips.text: Variance bars grow right for ahead of plan and left for behind, so the biggest misses are easy to find.
featureStrips.alt: Bars of actual minus plan per item, with increases to the right and decreases to the left of zero.

featureStrips.heading: Track a value against its accepted range
featureStrips.text: A target band draws the value over time inside a shaded range, so a month outside it stands out.
featureStrips.alt: Line of monthly actual values with a shaded accepted range and a dashed target line.

featureStrips.heading: Check if you are on pace for the year
featureStrips.text: A pace chart compares the cumulative actual with the cumulative plan and the final target.
featureStrips.alt: Cumulative actual and plan lines over a fiscal year, heading toward a final target.
